question: Where should the entire world be placed according to this teaching?
premises: The entire world is the subject under consideration.
It is said not to be placed elsewhere.
It is to be placed only in the guru.
inference: The entire world should be placed only in the guru.
uncertainties: astheyaṃ is an unusual form; taken as negated gerundive of placement.
plain_english: The entire world is not to be placed elsewhere; it is to be placed only in the guru.
